keyword: concrete pump hopper capacity on the order

title.en: Read the Hopper Cell Before You Order a Xingtai Pump
title.zh: 订邢台的泵之前先读料斗格

description.en: Hopper volume at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai is a printed cell, from 0.1 m³ on Electric 10 Series to 0.7 m³ on Electric 60 and Electric 80. Pages that omit it, including Electric 15 and HBT80-16, stay omitted.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的料斗容积是印出来的格子，从电动10系列的 0.1 m³ 到电动60和电动80的 0.7 m³。电动15和 HBT80-16 等没有印的页面保持不印。

h1.en: Order the Hopper That the Page Prints
h1.zh: 按页面印出的料斗下单

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints hopper capacity only on some sheets. Electric 20 is 0.25 m³. Electric 30 and Electric Low Pressure 40 are 0.3 m³. Electric 40, Electric 50, Diesel 40, Diesel 50, Diesel 60 and both mixer pumps are 0.4 m³. Electric Low Pressure 60 is 0.5 m³. LZ-80 and Diesel 120 are 0.6 m³. Electric 60 and Electric 80 are 0.7 m³. Electric 10 Series is 0.1 m³. The rural diesel is 0.2 m³. If the cell is missing, the order says “not printed”.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）只在部分表上印料斗容积。电动20是 0.25 m³。电动30和电动低压40是 0.3 m³。电动40、电动50、柴油40、柴油50、柴油60和两台搅拌泵是 0.4 m³。电动低压60是 0.5 m³。LZ-80 和柴油120是 0.6 m³。电动60和电动80是 0.7 m³。电动10系列是 0.1 m³。农村柴油泵是 0.2 m³。格子缺失时，订单写“未印”。

body.en: Electric 15, HBT8018, HBT80-16 and LZ-60 do not print a hopper volume on the lists used here. Tractor-Driven 4100 does: 0.25 m³, the same figure as Electric 20, on a different machine.
body.zh: 电动15、HBT8018、HBT80-16 和 LZ-60 在此处使用的列表上不印料斗容积。拖拉机带动4100印了：0.25 m³，数字与电动20相同，机器不同。

heading.en: Do not convert hopper into output
heading.zh: 不要把料斗换算成输送量

body.en: The catalogue does not print cylinder bore, stroke or strokes per minute. A 0.4 m³ hopper is not a formula for m³/h. Use the output cell that is already printed.
body.zh: 目录不印缸径、行程或每分钟冲程。0.4 m³ 料斗不是 m³/h 的公式。使用已经印出的输送量格。

body.en: Paste the printed hopper, or write that the page has none, plus the model path, to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not price hoppers as a separate public line on the pump page.
body.zh: 把印出的料斗，或写明该页没有，连同型号路径发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。河北品锦机械不在泵页上把料斗列为单独的公开价格行。

question.zh: 电动15的料斗是 0.25 m³ 吗？

answer.en: That figure is not on the Electric 15 sheet. Do not borrow it.
answer.zh: 电动15的表上没有这个数字。不要借用。

answer.en: Both the electric mixer and the diesel mixer print 0.4 m³.
answer.zh: 电动搅拌泵和柴油搅拌泵都印 0.4 m³。

question.en: Is M9’s 115 L a trailer hopper?
question.zh: M9 的 115 L 是拖泵料斗吗？

answer.en: No. It is the plaster sprayer’s hopper. It is not a concrete-pump cell.
answer.zh: 不是。它是石膏喷涂机的料斗。不是混凝土泵的格子。

question.en: Does a larger hopper mean a printed surcharge?
question.zh: 更大的料斗是否有已印加价？

answer.en: No surcharge table is printed. Ask Xingtai.
answer.zh: 没有印加价表。请问邢台。
